text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gunmen kill 22 villagers, including 14 women, in Menaa village in Boufarik area, south of Algiers.
- A half-hour raid was enough to claim the lives of 22 people in Menaa.
- Aissa Nouasri, leader of the main workers union, says government, business and union representatives will meet on April 24 to discuss salary hikes.
- About 50 "terrorists" slaughtered 22 people in Menaa village and about 100 villagers, who survived the massacre, said they would leave the hamlet.
- Four people killed in a car bomb explosion near Boufarik on Saturday.
- Algeria to celebrate Eid al-Adha on Thursday.
